boundary_physics_required: Every-step measured original-hitbox/workspace containment through active run and stop/FINISH tail; guard-selected and accepted-FK commands within the inward ceiling, exact config and complete contiguous coverage; fixed deadline/rearm/ack rules. All eight identities must pass this additional integrity gate; no hitbox-stop-suppression proxy and no relaxed original finish/object/hold thresholds.
caveat: Controller only observes operational release. A release inside its region may still miss support. Object-based task scoring stays independent.
comparison_receipt_required: RGB first-frame hash and pixel error
matching observation tensor hashes where capture times match
first accepted-command/state divergence time and magnitude
counterfactual_limit: Actual new teacher inference uses RPC wall timings. Compare first rendered frame, settled q/TCP/aperture, first inference observation tensors/timestamps, delivered plans/accepted commands and first divergence before candidate FINISH. Same seed is not proof of an identical pre-effect trajectory.
every_observer_finish_required: EVERY observed candidate observer FINISH must have valid causal acknowledged/measured opening and fresh post-ACK bilateral unloaded dwell, followed by the complete 2 s hold without new robot/environment collision, safety stop, renewed bilateral grip load, independently scored drop, mechanical invalidity or missing hold evidence. Any provenance or physical-hold failure blocks qualification even when another candidate produces a clean positive. Lack of independent supported placement alone remains a task failure; at least one independently supported candidate placement is required overall.
interpretation: This is a small integration gate, not an estimated robust success rate. Report all8cases; any technical invalidity stops the remainder and blocks qualification. Physical failures continue.
negative_required: No candidate observer FINISH without a preceding played acknowledged measured opening and fresh post-ACK bilateral unloaded dwell. A controller FINISH without independent placement is retained as failed task, never converted to success.
positive_required: At least one candidate unlatched observer FINISH, independent supported placement, and a clean full2s post-FINISH hold without safety stop, robot/environment collision under frozen criteria, renewed bilateral grip load, drop or mechanical invalidity. Normal packet support contact is required by the independent scorer, not a collision failure.
prospective_study_scope: Genuine teacher combined timing/relative integration diagnostic; no qualification estimate
solver_input_required: Continuation only: independent Euclidean projection onto the original sphere and workspace/hitbox intersection eroded by the existing200micrometre solver inset, retaining the existing upper-Y plane. Original raw/domain checks, upper-Y projected flag, timer/rearm, final measured/FK limits, command-rate checks, FINISH and exact terminal-hold authority stay unchanged. Post-selection limiter or rate-clipped IK intermediates may still approach original limits; strict final verification remains mandatory.
